milestone_summary: ATR labs in Kyoto reconstructed 10x10-pixel images a person viewed from brain signals.

quote: Both men, Vilbis forgotten but watching with bright eyes, were studying the small dots in the tri-di.
claim_description: Three-dimensional holographic display spheres are used for tracking ships.
concept_description: A display that shows images, maps or people as volumetric three-dimensional pictures viewable from several sides.
milestone_summary: Lloyd Cross produced a hologram recreating a moving 3-dimensional image (Multiplex hologram, viewable around a cylinder)

quote: in its analysis of, for instance, a manuscript, […] not only conveyed the ideas expressed in that manuscript, but also the author's personality, the smell of his room, the feel of his paper and the ideas he had hidden between the lines of that manuscript.
claim_description: A machine with five multi-range senses working in concert, translating perceptions into visual form, can infer an author's personality, environment and hidden ideas from a manuscript.
concept_name: Artificial senses of touch, taste and smell
concept_description: Sensors that give machines a sense of touch, taste, smell or hearing comparable to or better than a person's.
milestone_summary: Bell Labs (Balashek, Biddulph, Davis) built Audrey, a single-speaker spoken-digit recognizer: a machine sense of hearing.

quote: If it were only a little faster (and these technological improvements always come) it would out-class us completely.
claim_description: Predicts that faster chess computers will inevitably outclass all human players.
concept_description: A computer program that plays chess, eventually at or beyond the level of the best human players.
milestone_summary: Fidelity Electronics released Chess Challenger, the first dedicated chess computer sold to the public.

quote: Plot a one-gee orbit to Phobos, McGuire. Take-off in five minutes.
claim_description: A spaceship whose integral computer brain takes spoken orders, plots a constant one-gravity acceleration course and handles launch and countdown itself.
concept_description: A machine that recognizes spoken words and carries out spoken commands, such as voice-operated doors or computers.
milestone_summary: The Apricot Portable shipped with voice-command recognition (up to 4096 words, 64 in RAM at a time).

quote: one of Dunark's new mechanical educators, with complete instructions for its use.
claim_description: A machine that reads a brain and transfers knowledge into another person's mind.
concept_description: A machine or computer that presents lessons, tests students and grades their answers automatically.
milestone_summary: PLATO I began operating on the University of Illinois ILLIAC I computer as the first generalized computer-assisted instruction system.

quote: I want to congratulate whoever did it, and I don't much care whether the answer comes from you or ECAIAC!
claim_description: A giant computer, ECAIAC, is used by the state to solve murder cases through automated deduction.
concept_name: Computer crime detection and predictive policing
concept_description: Computers that analyse police records and evidence to identify suspects or predict where crime will happen.
milestone_summary: The FBI's National Crime Information Center, a computerized national database of wanted persons and stolen property, was created.

quote: the tank was seven hundred feet in diameter and eighty feet thick in the middle—over seventeen million cubic feet of space in which more than two million tiny lights crawled hither and thither in hopeless confusion.
claim_description: A giant three-dimensional galactic display tank tracking millions of fleet units in real time.
concept_description: A display that shows images, maps or people as volumetric three-dimensional pictures viewable from several sides.
milestone_summary: Lloyd Cross produced a hologram recreating a moving 3-dimensional image (Multiplex hologram, viewable around a cylinder)

quote: But the computer had already taken over, and was controlling the flow of water to the hydrostatic balance tank system, rapidly orienting the axis of spin against the true axis of the wheel.
claim_description: A computer automatically rebalances a spinning space station by shifting water between tanks.
concept_description: A computer that runs the life support, systems and operations of a space station or colony.
milestone_summary: Skylab launched with an onboard digital computer controlling its attitude and pointing.

quote: the red spark that represented the *Ertak* glowed like a coal of fire; all around were the green pinpricks of light that showed the position of other bodies around us.

quote: part of a TV reading machine of the sort that could use micro-libraries all over America.
claim_description: Television reading machines access microfilm libraries across the country remotely.
concept_description: A machine that stores very large collections of records or documents and finds the items matching a query in seconds.
milestone_summary: Lockheed's interactive Dialog system (Roger Summit) was tested on NASA's STAR database at Ames in 1966, cutting searches from 14 hours to a few minutes; this became NASA RECON.
